title: Adverbial clauses of reason with because / since / as · 基础巩固(第3轮)
summary: Reason adverbial clauses: because is strongest, since/as introduce reasons both sides already know.本课为基础巩固练习,核心:because gives a direct reason; since/as gives a known reason; tone weakens in turn。
points: because answers why, strongest tone
since = since, based on a known fact
as = as, weakest tone
now that = since
when because is used, so is not used in the main clause

questions.prompt: _____ you know the answer, please tell us.
options: Since

So
questions.explanation: 考查because gives a direct reason; since/as gives a known reason; tone weakens in turn。此处应为 Since。句意:既然你知道答案,请告诉我们。

title: Adverbial clauses of concession with although / though · 基础巩固(第3轮)
summary: although/though introduces a concession: cannot be used together with but.本课为基础巩固练习,核心:although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。
points: although = though, placed at the start
the main clause cannot use but, but can use yet/still
even though has a stronger tone
though can appear at the end of a sentence
despite/in spite of + noun also express concession

examples.zh: 虽然天很冷,我们旅行得很愉快。

examples.en: Though he is young, he knows a lot.

examples.zh: 尽管任务很难,我们还是完成了。

examples.zh: 虽然生病了,他还是通过了考试。

questions.explanation: 考查although + clause: 'although...but' cannot be used together in the same sentence。此处应为 though。句意:虽然生病了,他还是通过了考试。

title: Adverbials of purpose with to / in order to · 基础巩固(第3轮)
summary: Adverbials of purpose express purpose: to/in order to + base verb, so that + clause.本课为基础巩固练习,核心:to + base verb = in order to; so that introduces a clause。
points: to + base verb is the most common
in order to emphasizes purpose
so as to / in order to can be placed at the start
so that + subject + can/may + base verb
in order not to / so as not to express a negative purpose

examples.en: I got up early to catch the first bus.

title: both / either / neither · 基础巩固(第3轮)
summary: both/either/neither express the quantity relationships of two objects; mind singular and plural agreement.本课为基础巩固练习,核心:both = both (affirmative), neither = neither (negative), either = either of two options。
points: both...and... connects two parallel parts
neither...nor... neither...nor...
either...or... either...or...
both of them are / neither of them is
the subject connected by either...or agrees with the nearer one (proximity principle)

title: used to past habits · 基础巩固(第3轮)

points: used to + base verb
the negative is didn't use to / used not to
the question is Did...use to...?
be used to + V-ing = accustomed to (different meaning)
often contrasted with now

title: as...as comparisons · 基础巩固(第3轮)
summary: as...as expresses 'as...as'; the negative not as...as means 'not as...as'.本课为基础巩固练习,核心:as + adjective/adorb base form + as; the negative is not as/so...as。
points: as + adjective base form + as
the negative is not as/so + adjective + as
the same...as = the same as

title: Present perfect have/has + past participle · 典型例句(第3轮)
summary: have/has + past participle expresses an action that happened in the past and its impact on the present.本课为典型例句练习,核心:Present perfect emphasizes the present result and impact of a past action。
points: have/has + past participle
often with already, yet, just, ever, never
the negative is haven't/hasn't + past participle
Have you ever...? asks about experience
distinguish from the past simple: no specific past time is given

title: both / either / neither · 典型例句(第3轮)
summary: both/either/neither express the quantity relationships of two objects; mind singular and plural agreement.本课为典型例句练习,核心:both = both (affirmative), neither = neither (negative), either = either of two options。
points: both...and... connects two parallel parts
neither...nor... neither...nor...
either...or... either...or...
both of them are / neither of them is

title: Relative clauses where / when · 情景运用(第3轮)
summary: Relational adverbs introduce relative clauses: where = in which, when = on which.本课为情景运用练习,核心:where modifies a place, when modifies a time, acting as an adverbial inside the clause。
points: where modifies a place antecedent: the school where I study
when modifies a time antecedent: the day when we met
where can be rewritten as prep + which
when can be rewritten as on/in which
why modifies the antecedent reason
